projects.description: Successfully completed terrace waterproofing work at Max Hospital, Mankapur, Nagpur, covering approximately 16,000 sq. ft. Our team focused on providing a durable and reliable waterproofing solution to protect the building from water seepage and leakage.
projects.problem: The terrace required an effective waterproofing system to prevent water penetration, leakage and moisture-related damage to the building structure.
projects.inspection: Our technical team inspected the terrace surface, identified critical joints, cracks and vulnerable areas, and evaluated the surface condition before selecting the appropriate waterproofing system.
projects.solution: Proper surface preparation was carried out, followed by treatment of cracks and joints. A suitable waterproofing coating system was applied as per site requirements to ensure uniform coverage and effective protection.
projects.result: The terrace waterproofing work was completed with proper surface coverage and finishing, providing enhanced protection against water seepage and improving the durability of the structure.
